CustomField.description: Computed call duration in minutes, rounded down. Returns blank until both start and end times are set.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Call_Start_DateTime__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Call_End_DateTime__c))), FLOOR((Call_End_DateTime__c - Call_Start_DateTime__c) * 24 * 60), NULL )
CustomField.label: Duration (minutes)
